source.name: Original KlusAI / Codex synthetic hard-negative prose and fictional subjects
source.attribution: KlusAI / Codex, 2026; original prose, no external text source

family_policy: New train-only families, not amendments to frozen gateway-v1 test/dev reservations. Three task variants per language/family; language adaptations share family IDs.
subject_policy: 64 new fictional contacts per language; normalized name/email/phone/address values exclude all parent TRAIN and current dev/test identifying values. No private heldout subject pool is reused.
negative_policy: Product/packaging words, article codes, fictional merchant labels, receipt/table headings, status phrases and public historical figures are utility negatives. Public names/words may recur across splits; private subjects and task templates must not.
inventory_policy: Append the hash-bound KP artifact to the training inventory before model use; no publication by this task.
